title: `thread '<unnamed>' panicked at 'attempt to subtract with overflow'` when attempting to parse date
body:
### Polars version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://crates.io/crates/polars) of Polars.


### Issue description

Attempting to parse dates of the form `\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}` leads to a crash, `thread '<unnamed>' panicked at 'attempt to subtract with overflow'`.

### Reproducible example

Features: `["lazy", "temporal", "strings", "concat_str"]`.

MRE:
```rust
let df = df![
    "year"=> &[2020, 2021, 2022],
    "month"=> &[1, 2, 3],
    "day"=> &[1, 2, 3],
]
.unwrap()
.lazy();

let df = df.with_column(
    concat_str([col("year"), col("month"), col("day")], "-")  // produces e.g., `2020-1-1`
        .str()
        .strptime(StrpTimeOptions {
            date_dtype: DataType::Datetime(TimeUnit::Milliseconds, None),
            fmt: Some("%Y-%m-%_d".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .alias("dt1"),
);

println!("{:?}", df.collect()?);
```
